# Turtleand

> Where Humans and Technology Evolve Together. Personal ecosystem exploring AI, growth engineering, software craft, and blockchain.

## Main Sites
- [Growth Blog](https://growth.turtleand.com/llms.txt): Essays on AI, technology, human potential, and personal growth
- [AI Lab](https://lab.turtleand.com/llms.txt): 6-module hands-on curriculum for building practical LLM tools and agents
- [Build](https://build.turtleand.com/llms.txt): Engineering fundamentals, software craft, and deep technical understanding
- [Blockchain](https://decentralized.turtleand.com/llms.txt): Decentralized systems, identity, and ownership infrastructure
- [Hermes Lab](https://hermes.turtleand.com/llms.txt): Hermes Agent field notes, troubleshooting guides, and voice-first workflows

## Secondary Learning Surfaces
- [Energy](https://energy.turtleand.com/llms.txt): Electricity, circuits, power, storage, grids, and physical energy systems

## About
- [About Turtleand](https://turtleand.com/about): Software engineer with 10+ years building production systems, focused on AI integration and human-centered technology
- Avatar Evolution Gallery: Open the Turtleand logo to explore the static archive and the animated six-stage vector evolution
- [Turtleand Feeds](https://turtleand.com/feeds/): Feed registry for subscribing to Turtleand public knowledge surfaces
